Introduction
Accurate Prototype Possible with Novel SPICE Models
Typical PLECS models, often based on lab conditions, may not accurately predict real-world component behavior. The engine under the SSPMG hood is
onsemi
’s
physical & scalable SPICE models
. These models provide an accurate and efficient way to simulate the behavior of power devices in a power electronics circuit, reducing the time required for product development.
New onsemi Gate Driver Product Support in SSPMG
The latest enhancement to
onsemi
’s Self‑Service PLECS Model Generator: the integration of onsemi gate drivers directly into the tool. The performance of power devices, such as SiC MOSFETs and IGBTs, captured within PLECS models is strongly influenced by the behavior of the gate driver.
Traditional simulation-based PLECS model generation typically relies on idealized gate‑drive pulses, which can introduce inaccuracies in the predicted switching performance. Now, designers gain access to more accurate PLECS models that enable higher confidence, system‑level design.
